Finding: API key hardcoded in wrangler.toml
Notes: PROJECTHUB_API_KEY committed in plain text

Finding: Unauthenticated membership invite endpoint
Notes: Any caller could trigger Hub API invitations with no auth

Finding: Unverified webhook triggers privileged invite
Notes: No secret verification before processing donations

Finding: Webhook secret exposed in URL query param
Notes: v2 fix used ?secret=TOKEN — logged by Cloudflare/proxy access logs. Moved to X-Webhook-Secret header

Finding: Timing attack on token comparison
Notes: !== operator used for secret comparison — replaced with timingSafeEqual

Finding: Secret key logged to browser console
Notes: console.log("PUBLIC_SECRET_KEY:", SECRET_KEY) in client-side code

Finding: Full donor PII payload echoed in HTTP response
Notes: Raw payload including donor email returned in webhook response body

Finding: Middleware cached POST/API responses as public
Notes: Cache-Control set to public max-age=600 for all responses including API

Finding: No rate limiting on any endpoint
Notes: Cloudflare WAF rate limiting applied in v6. Re-verified 2026-09-22: POST returns 429 after ~10 requests; GET returns 429 from ~request 77 of a 300-request burst — active but far above the 15/60s threshold v6 recorded. Threshold and the 500s that precede it tracked as S-4

Finding: Wildcard CORS on all endpoints including write endpoints
Notes: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on POST endpoints removed

Finding: membership-invite proxied arbitrary body fields to Hub API
Notes: Only whitelisted fields (email/type/paymentReference) now forwarded

Finding: No CSRF/Origin check on form submission endpoints
Notes: Origin header check added — returns 403 for non-techforpalestine.org origins

Finding: No input format or length validation on forms
Notes: Email regex; URL via new URL(); 2000 char limit on all text fields

Finding: getEnv globalThis fallback allowed client-side secret resolution
Notes: globalThis[name] fallback resolved to window[name] in browser context

Finding: Donor PII (full email) written to server logs
Notes: All log calls now redact to [redacted]@domain.com

Finding: Internal error.message leaked in HTTP response bodies
Notes: catch blocks returned raw error messages to clients

Finding: Dual middleware files — cache-control layer was dead code
Notes: Astro loaded src/middleware.ts only — index.ts never ran. Refactored to sequence(cacheControl csp) with separate files

Finding: PUBLIC_SECRET_KEY in client-side Axios Authorization header bundle
Notes: Secret was bundled into browser JS via Axios instance headers. Replaced with server-side proxy

Finding: CSP script-src used 'unsafe-inline' defeating XSS protection
Notes: Per-request nonce via crypto.randomUUID() + HTMLRewriter + strict-dynamic

Finding: project-proxy forwarded Authorization to any upstream path
Notes: Only leading / was checked — any upstream endpoint reachable with auth. Path now must start with /api/method/

Finding: project-proxy dot-segment traversal bypassed /api/method/ prefix check
Notes: /api/method/../../admin passed prefix check but fetch() normalised to /admin. Fixed with new URL() normalisation before guard

Finding: Notion DB IDs committed in wrangler.toml
Notes: Database IDs moved to Cloudflare Pages dashboard environment variables

Finding: QGiv embed script loaded without Subresource Integrity hash
OWASP: A08:2021 – Software and Data Integrity Failures
Notes: No integrity attribute on dynamically injected script tag — supply chain risk. Injection point moved from MembershipPage.tsx in the membership rebuild and now also appears on the donate page

Finding: Notion image proxy worker had no authentication
Notes: Worker removed entirely in PR #415 — finding closed

Finding: style-src 'unsafe-inline' in CSP remained after script-src was nonce-protected
Notes: Nonce applied to style-src; HTMLRewriter extended to inject nonce into <style> tags

Finding: project-proxy forwarded all browser request headers to upstream including Cookie and X-Forwarded-For
Notes: Replaced header copy-all with explicit FORWARD_HEADERS allowlist (content-type/accept/accept-language/accept-encoding only)

Finding: Membership/donation completion endpoints grant Hub invites and mailing-list writes behind a spoofable Origin check
Notes: PR #489 deleted the signature-verified qgiv-webhook and the Bearer-authed membership-invite; the replacement is triggered client-side from a QGiv DOM event and gated only on the Origin header. Confirmed live: forged Origin reaches validation (400) instead of 403. No payment verification anywhere in the path

Finding: Security response headers absent on every SSR page
Notes: public/_headers only applies to Cloudflare Pages static assets; with output: server nearly every HTML route is a Function response. Confirmed live: / has no X-Frame-Options / nosniff / Referrer-Policy / Permissions-Policy while /favicon.png has all four. CSP also has no frame-ancestors

Finding: Authenticated admin dashboard served with Cache-Control: public max-age=600
Notes: Middleware marks every non-API GET without its own header as public max-age=600 including /admin/conversions. RFC 9111 §3.5: public is the directive that permits a shared cache to store a response to an Authorization-bearing request. Confirmed live on the 401

Finding: Uncached Notion-backed GET routes return 500 under load before the GET rate limit engages
File: Cloudflare WAF config; src/pages/api/faq.ts; ideas.ts; speakers.ts; events.ts
Notes: 300-request burst on /api/faq: ~76 x 200, then 13 x 500 several of them before the first 429, then 429s mixed with 200s. faq/ideas/speakers/e4p-signatories issue a Notion query per request and events fetches the full ICS per request with no cache; only /api/projects caches. GET rate limit is active but sits above the point where the upstreams fail

Finding: Token-bearing events feed URL reaches error telemetry unscrubbed
OWASP: A09:2021 – Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
Notes: EVENTS_ICS_URL embeds an auth token as a query param. Fetch failures go to console.error and Sentry.captureException; the Sentry Cloudflare SDK records outbound fetch URLs as breadcrumbs and neither config sets beforeSend/beforeBreadcrumb

Finding: Astro runtime two majors behind with published RCE/SSRF/XSS advisories in the pinned range
Notes: astro 5.18.1: GHSA-26w7-cxv4-gfx2 (AVIF RCE 9.8 — mitigated by imageService: cloudflare); GHSA-2pvr-wf23-7pc7 (Host-header SSRF 7.5); GHSA-8hv8-536x-4wqp (slot-name XSS 7.1). Also svelte 5.55.5 and axios 1.16.0 in-range fixes; react-router-dom and install are declared but unused

Finding: Per-request CSP nonce republished in a DOM-readable meta tag
Notes: CSP deliberately hides the nonce attribute from the DOM; meta name=csp-nonce restores a readable copy. Needed today only to nonce MUI/Emotion runtime styles alongside three global prototype patches (createElement/setAttribute/innerHTML)

Finding: Raw-HTML sink renders upstream error text in the volunteer form
Notes: dangerouslySetInnerHTML on err.message from the Frappe upstream which echoes submitted values. Script execution blocked by the nonce CSP; markup injection is not. Latent — project-proxy returns 503 Proxy not configured in production. Line 100 also console.logs applicant PII

Finding: /api/pipe accepts requests with no Origin and from any *.pages.dev host
Notes: allowMissingOrigin: true lets any non-browser client inject Plausible events and write attacker-controlled records into the DROPPED_CONVERSIONS KV namespace. allowedSuffixes .pages.dev covers every Cloudflare Pages site; the other endpoints pin .website-aun.pages.dev

Finding: Third-party analytics script re-served first-party without integrity pinning
OWASP: A08:2021 – Software and Data Integrity Failures
Notes: Proxies plausible.io/js/pa-*.js and re-serves it from the site origin with public max-age=86400 so it runs under script-src 'self' with no SRI and a 24h cache window
